findings.finding: The visible scientific branches are successive ancestors of the pinned public publication tip; older branch names do not by themselves supply competing fresh evidence. The early GDT001 compression summary and dynamic-rank stop are byte-identical across their old branch and the public tip.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: Named-ref ancestry does not establish correctness, inclusion of every uncommitted file, or recovery of every reflog artifact. The separate inventory audit owns those wider checks. No claim that every abandoned hypothesis has been scientifically tested.

findings.finding: Ordered reusable parts, exact-symbol inner transition information, familiar phrase-family covariance and whole-form weighting have real qualified support. They must remain in the compressed research memory alongside failures.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: GDT916 does not establish new-stem-pair generalization. GDT1308 predicts known whole forms better but does not identify a stored medieval dictionary. GDT865 preserves two thresholds, not the entire original808verdict. Alternate transcriptions and historically exposed folds are not independent manuscript confirmation.

findings.finding: The critical gap is not simply a lack of successful source controls. Some high recovery controls receive the architecture, roles or expansion inventory; deriving those missing inputs without pairing remains unsuccessful under tested contracts.
findings.specific_contrast: The live control topic retains GDT833 conditional recovery of 5519/5519 words and GDT1160 context/neural gains. In contrast, GDT1164 unpaired top-5 recovery is 2.042%, against 4.443% for frequency and 11.832% for the simpler fingerprint. GDT1171 finds no useful registered context increment on its open expansion task.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: These failures do not prove that context, neural models, abbreviation or languages cannot work. They do prevent promoting an unchanged candidate pipeline or presenting source-control percentages as native translation accuracy.

findings.finding: A diagnostic pass must not overwrite an original failed contract, and an unknown search is neither failure nor a surviving complete reading.
findings.specifics: GDT616 strict Stage A is UNSAT; later relaxation does not authorize Stage B. GDT1097 has three solver-INFEASIBLE cases and four UNKNOWNs, with no full code. GDT1247 weak projection passes all four UNKNOWNs and all three old INFEASIBLE cases, so its pass cannot certify the stronger model.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: 1097negative solver reports have no independently replayed mathematical certificates. Its explicit park decision rules out an automatic runtime/encoding-repair chain; no fresh solver run is recommended here.

findings.finding: GDT1317 disproves a universal inference from failure on raw unseen-word score to absence of a true component generator. Preserve that logical correction without rehabilitating GDT1316.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: GDT1316 retains its positive aggregate gain and failed registered conjunction. GDT1317 is a constructed source-free counterexample, not a native mechanism, measured false-negative rate or reason to retune the original gate.

findings.finding: Recent complete-source accounting, inverse demonstrations and necessary writer exclusions have not added a native lexical reading. The current f83r whole-page drafts explicitly justify zero new lexical values;1014Deot preflight excludes that exact source projection only.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: This does not make construction proofs worthless or show Voynich untranslatable. It means their practical output is a scoped constraint or a candidate cost, not translated words or proof of a particular source language.

findings.finding: A coherent exploratory whole reading may be attempted before a confirmed seed word or independent discriminator exists. Each adopted concrete meaning still owes its actual word profile, distribution and counterexamples; unsupported values remain unassigned.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: Do not turn absence of a discriminator into a prohibition on thinking. Conversely, imaginative story completion cannot be reported as supported lexical assignment. A fixed semantic preference needs consequences that separate the actual rivals.

findings.finding: Seven canonical IDEA IDs were shadowed by HIST aliases. The registry audit reports an exact-ID-first fix, 29 passing tests and successful replay of all seven IDs, preserving historical records and real alias ambiguity.
findings.own_observation: An earlier source-led pass by this producer directly encountered the IDEA000844 ambiguous-alias error; this audit did not independently rerun the29test suite.
findings.counterevidence_and_limits: This restores retrieval, not meanings or reopened scientific routes. Publication reconciliation and stale review-basis flags remain separate tasks; a clean lookup is not scientific validation.

translation_progress_standard.real_manuscript_progress: A new source-faithful observation or a robustly scoped structural restriction changes what a human writing mechanism must explain; retain its exact premises and any surviving alternatives.
translation_progress_standard.exploratory_semantic_progress: A complete or explicitly partial shared reading assigns justified candidate values, preserves all unread spans, and derives a new content consequence that was not supplied merely by the desired story. It may remain unconfirmed.
translation_progress_standard.translation_evidence: A frozen shared reading recovers additional literal content or independently constrained meaning, while genuine competing readings make different predictions; all source ambiguities, profile counterexamples and search-selection costs remain visible.
not_equivalent_to_translation: More toy roundtrips or a bijection that decodes every string by construction.
A model surviving a weak necessary condition, especially where stronger failures already exist.
A fluent paragraph obtained from many new singleton glosses without their distributional account.
A high control score with supplied architecture/candidates or an AUC presented as translated-word percentage.
Finding a historical mechanism that can carry content without binding it to actual Voynich signs.
Counting older branches, transcription variants, repeated validation or inherited report copies as independent evidence.
